events.title: Government signs Google MoU for AI adoption
events.date_basis: Dated article explicitly identifies Thursday's MoU signing.
events.summary: Andhra Pradesh signed a Google MoU covering AI in healthcare, sustainability, government-service pilots, skills and startup support.
events.limitations: Signed commitment, not completed pilots or verified benefits. The original Google press release was described but not separately retrieved.

events.title: Government signs Microsoft AI skills agreement
events.date_basis: Article first published 13 March explicitly says agreement signed Thursday; 14 March is the update date.
events.summary: The state and Microsoft signed an agreement for AI and advanced-technology training covering youth, teachers and public officials.
events.limitations: Training figures are commitments and target groups, not verified completions; overlapping participant categories should not be summed.

events.title: Minister announces AI voice services for Mana Mitra
events.date_basis: Dated Assembly report identifies the minister's statement on Tuesday.
events.summary: Andhra Pradesh announced planned AI-enabled voice services and chatbot improvements for its Mana Mitra WhatsApp governance platform.
events.limitations: The 100-day target is prospective. Existing WhatsApp service use does not demonstrate deployment of the announced AI capability.

events.title: State begins AI governance workshop with Wadhwani
events.date_basis: Partner-hosted report explicitly dates first workshop day to 24 April; separate report dates second day to 25 April.
events.summary: Andhra Pradesh began an AI governance workshop for public officials, linking training to departmental project selection and proofs of concept.
events.initiative: Andhra Pradesh AI Champions capacity building
events.limitations: Wadhwani's page republishes The Hindu and is not independent corroboration. Follow-on project targets are not completed applications.

events.title: Government approves guidelines for AI-capable data-centre policy
events.date_basis: Date printed on G.O.Ms.No.12 and its annexure.
events.summary: The state approved operating guidelines for its data-centre incentive policy, which explicitly seeks investment in AI-capable data infrastructure.
events.limitations: This is a wider data-centre policy with a substantive AI objective, not an AI-only programme. Earlier policy-order references conflict within the document; only the guidelines approval is dated here.

events.title: Government signs NVIDIA MoU for proposed AI university
events.date_basis: Dated report describes the agreement and meeting on Friday 6 June.
events.summary: Andhra Pradesh and NVIDIA agreed to support a proposed AI university, engineering-student training, research infrastructure and startup participation.
events.limitations: The university remains proposed in the source. Training 10,000 students and helping up to 500 startups apply are targets, not verified outcomes.

events.title: RTGS reports AI search across government documents
events.date_basis: Operational status reported at 16 September 2025 collectors' conference; actual deployment date unspecified.
events.summary: An RTGS official reported an introduced AI-based search interface with voice features for government documents, including government orders.
events.limitations: Operational status is the official's reported claim; no service test, coverage audit or deployment date was verified. Inclusion reflects documented in-period operation, not a known launch.

events.title: Cabinet approves Robotics and Physical AI Policy
events.date_basis: Both fetched reports explicitly date Tuesday's cabinet approval to 10 November 2026.
events.summary: Andhra Pradesh's cabinet approved its Robotics and Physical AI Policy, according to two same-day reports.
events.initiative: Andhra Pradesh Robotics and Physical AI Policy
events.limitations: Fresh cabinet reporting at the research cutoff; notification, policy text and implementation measures were not retrieved. Both accounts may rely on one cabinet briefing.

events.title: KITE begins responsible AI training for schoolteachers
events.date_basis: On-site reporting specifies 2 May; annual report confirms May 2024 commencement.
events.summary: KITE began hands-on AI training for secondary teachers, covering classroom tools, privacy, algorithmic bias and responsible use.
events.limitations: The 80,000 figure is the programme target in the launch report. The annual report records 31,878 trained in FY2024-25; reporting periods and later cumulative claims differ.

events.title: Class 7 AI curriculum announced for new school year
events.date_basis: IndiaAI announcement is dated 30 May and cites KITE; upcoming academic year begins 3 June.
events.summary: Kerala introduced AI learning in its revised Class 7 ICT textbook, including a computer-vision programming exercise.
events.limitations: Date is the public announcement, not an observed first classroom session. Four lakh students is intended reach, not a measured learning result.

events.title: State issues AI declaration at GenAI conclave
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous report dates Friday's closing declaration; official KSIDC page confirms its content.
events.summary: Kerala announced plans for a dedicated AI policy, infrastructure, startup support and departmental adoption at the GenAI conclave.
events.limitations: Promise to prepare a dedicated policy is not evidence of adoption. Incentives announced at the conclave are not verified disbursements.

events.title: KITE announces AI Essentials course for the public
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous dated announcement; actual classes were scheduled for 10 March.
events.summary: KITE opened a four-week public AI course covering practical tools and responsible use, with mentors and weekly contact classes.
events.limitations: The annual report calls February the launch and reports 500 people trained; this event uses the precise announcement date rather than assuming classes began that day.

events.title: Kerala inaugurates K-AI governance initiative
events.date_basis: Official Kerala State IT Mission page explicitly supplies inauguration date.
events.summary: Kerala inaugurated K-AI to connect government departments, startups, researchers and experts developing AI solutions for public services.
events.limitations: Programme inauguration does not establish deployment of particular AI services; source publication date is not given.

events.title: Cabinet approves IT policy with Kerala AI Mission provisions
events.date_basis: Dated report explicitly identifies cabinet approval on Friday 20 February.
events.summary: Kerala approved IT Policy 2026, whose AI mission section sets objectives for ethical governance, public-sector applications and workforce development.
events.limitations: The policy's ten-year mission, 50 solutions and 100,000 professionals are goals. Relationship to the earlier K-AI programme is not sufficiently defined to count them as unrelated missions.

sources.title: Google, Andhra Pradesh govt sign MoU for AI adoption
sources.evidence_excerpt: Google signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Government of Andhra Pradesh on Thursday
sources.evidence_summary: Dated report describes a signed MoU covering AI in health, sustainability, public-service pilots, skills and startups; it quotes a Google press release.

sources.title: Andhra Pradesh signs deal with Microsoft for skill development in artificial intelligence
sources.evidence_excerpt: signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Microsoft Corporation
sources.evidence_summary: Reports the state and Microsoft signed on Thursday 13 March, with training targets covering youth, teachers and government staff. First published 13 March, updated 14 March.

sources.title: More WhatsApp-based public services by June, says Andhra Pradesh IT Minister Lokesh
sources.evidence_excerpt: would introduce AI-enabled voice services in the next one hundred days
sources.evidence_summary: Assembly statement dated 18 March proposes AI voice services and chatbots in Mana Mitra. Existing WhatsApp transactions are not evidence that the AI upgrade had launched.

sources.title: A new era begins; AI must power governance with a human touch: Andhra Pradesh CM Chandrababu Naidu
sources.evidence_summary: Implementation partner's press page reproduces The Hindu reporting and identifies 24 April as the workshop's first day. It describes Wadhwani collaboration and officials' AI capacity building; not an independent second account.

sources.title: AI Champions will undergo four-day intensive training programme, says RTGS official
sources.evidence_excerpt: On the second day, 100 AI Champions and 200 AI Catalysts
sources.evidence_summary: Reports the second day of the training workshop and plans for department-specific proofs of concept. The 100-150 projects are envisaged outputs, not completed deployments.

sources.publisher: Government of Andhra Pradesh, ITE&C Department
sources.title: G.O.Ms.No.12: Data Center Policy (4.0) operating guidelines
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Government hereby accords approval for the Operating Guidelines
sources.evidence_summary: Signed order approves implementation guidelines for a data-centre policy that explicitly targets AI-capable infrastructure. Preamble and annexure refer to different earlier policy orders; retained event uses unambiguous 2 May 2025 guidelines approval.

sources.title: Govt. inks pact with NVIDIA on establishment of AI University in Andhra Pradesh
sources.evidence_summary: Reports a signed NVIDIA partnership for the proposed AI university, training 10,000 engineering students over two years, research and startup support. It does not report an operating university.

sources.title: RTGS Aware 2.0 to boost safety and governance in Andhra
sources.evidence_excerpt: An AI-based single search bar has also been introduced
sources.evidence_summary: Reports a state official's 16 September presentation that an AI search interface had been introduced for over 80 lakh government documents, including orders. Actual introduction date is unstated.

sources.title: AP cabinet approves major decisions
sources.evidence_excerpt: as well as the AP Robotics and Physical AI Policy
sources.evidence_summary: Dated 10 November 2026 report states the cabinet approved the robotics and physical AI policy that Tuesday; no underlying policy notification was fetched.

sources.title: AP Cabinet Clears AI Data Centres, Robotics Policy, Semiconductor Reforms and Major Industrial Projects
sources.evidence_excerpt: the Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026-36
sources.evidence_summary: Separate dated report corroborates cabinet approval on 10 November 2026 and specifies a 2026-36 policy horizon. Both publishers may rely on the same cabinet briefing.

sources.publisher: Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education
sources.title: Annual Report 2024-25
sources.evidence_excerpt: During 2024-25, 31878 teachers were trained in AI.
sources.evidence_summary: Official report retrospectively confirms May 2024 teacher training, Class 7 AI curriculum and February 2025 AI Essentials introduction. It reports 31,878 teachers trained in the fiscal year and 500 people trained through AI Essentials; these are reporting-period figures.

sources.title: AI training for teachers: How Kerala is raising the bar in classrooms
sources.evidence_summary: On-site reporting explicitly dates the training start to 2 May and describes sessions on responsible AI. The 80,000 teachers is the programme target in this contemporaneous account; publication day uses Indian local date.

sources.title: Kerala introduces Artificial Intelligence in school curriculums
sources.evidence_excerpt: the Information & Communication Technology ( ICT ) textbook of Class 7
sources.evidence_summary: Government AI portal reports the Class 7 curriculum change, cites KITE Kerala, and says the academic year starts 3 June. It forecasts coverage of more than four lakh students; no learning-outcome evaluation.

sources.title: Minister P. Rajeev makes AI policy announcement at the closing session of the International GenAI Conclave
sources.evidence_excerpt: will introduce a dedicated AI policy this fiscal year
sources.evidence_summary: Official investment agency records the conclave declaration promising a dedicated AI policy and support incentives. It has no publication date; contemporaneous reporting supplies the event date.

sources.title: International GenAI conclave ends with Kerala's declaration on AI
sources.evidence_excerpt: concluded here with a declaration by the State government on AI on Friday
sources.evidence_summary: Dated report identifies 12 July as the declaration date. Covers a proposed dedicated policy, AI cluster, startup support and public-sector adoption plans.

sources.title: KITE to conduct online AI programme for public
sources.evidence_summary: Contemporaneous announcement describes a four-week AI Essentials course, registration until 5 March and planned classes from 10 March. Annual report later calls the February introduction a launch; the record dates the announcement.

sources.title: K-AI
sources.evidence_summary: Official page explicitly dates inauguration by Kerala's Chief Secretary and describes a collaboration platform for departments, researchers and startups to develop ethical AI in governance.

sources.publisher: Government of Kerala, hosted by KFON
sources.title: Information Technology Policy 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Kerala AI Mission will be a 10- year programme
sources.evidence_summary: Section 7.3.3 sets out an AI mission, ethical governance, a target of 50 public-sector AI solutions and 100,000 skilled professionals. These are policy objectives, not achieved results.

sources.title: Kerala Cabinet approves IT Policy 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Kerala Cabinet on Friday approved
sources.evidence_summary: Dated report establishes cabinet approval on 20 February 2026 and identifies the Kerala AI Mission and responsible-technology measures within the wider IT policy.

excluded.reason: Search surfaced old projects surrounded by 2025 navigation links. No new in-window state action established.

excluded.reason: Corporate investment alone does not establish the specific state action. Kept outside this bounded set rather than attributing the full private investment to state policy spending.

excluded.reason: Automated telephone feedback is not necessarily AI; retrieved reporting did not establish a substantive AI component.

excluded.reason: Political forecasts of lower healthcare and agriculture costs are not verified measured outcomes; excluded from event summary and metrics.

notes: Extension covers Andhra Pradesh and Kerala for 2024-01-01 through 2026-11-10. It adds evidence-led examples, not a completeness claim or state ranking.
All 19 retained source URLs were read using Exa web_fetch_exa. Tavily extract returned HTTP429 on the first batch and research switched to Exa. Prior Firecrawl credit exhaustion was not retried.
Same-day 10 November 2026 AP cabinet reports were fetched after their publication times. They support approval reporting, not a gazetted or implemented policy.

The AP data-centre guidelines contain inconsistent references to the original policy order. Record AP-2025-04 uses the internally consistent guidelines order date, 2 May 2025, and does not assert an original policy adoption date.
AP-2025-06 has unknown deployment date but documented in-window operational status. Do not replace its null event_date with publication_date or a fabricated day.

KITE's 80,000 teacher target, annual 31,878 completions and later cumulative media claims use different scopes or periods. No inference of a final target shortfall is justified from the annual figure alone.
Source S-AP-04 explicitly identifies The Hindu as its online source. Hosting by an implementation partner does not make republished news independent primary evidence.

AI-linked IT and data-centre policies are included only where a substantive AI mission or capability objective is explicit. General digitisation, robotics or automated phone calls alone do not qualify.

Kerala's 2024 promise of a dedicated AI policy, 2025 K-AI inauguration and 2026 AI mission provisions are distinct milestones. The documents do not establish three unrelated missions or a completed standalone policy in 2024.
Targets, proposed universities, intended course reach, project counts and expected benefits are never counted as completed outcomes.
Source titles have been normalised to avoid em dashes in written outputs; URLs remain literal. No repository modifications or commits were made by this research task.
